title: E-Commerce & Shopify JSON-LD Schema, AI Crawler robots.txt, Broken-Link & llms.txt Auditor Input

action.title: Audit Action
action.description: Select the full unified store/URL audit or an individual deterministic check.

url.title: Store or Product Page URL / Domain
url.description: Target e-commerce store domain or product page URL to audit (e.g. https://www.allbirds.com).

urls.title: Batch Store URLs (Optional, up to 25)
urls.description: Optional list of up to 25 e-commerce store or product URLs for batch auditing (charged_results_only=True).

max_links.title: Max Internal/Product Links to Check
max_links.description: Maximum number of internal or product links to verify for 404s and redirect chains (1..50).

generate_remediation_pack.title: Generate Remediation Pack (/llms.txt + Fixed Product JSON-LD)
generate_remediation_pack.description: Deterministically generate a ready-to-paste /llms.txt file and corrected Schema.org/Product JSON-LD snippet.
